messages.subject: dMinAbd and dMinSamp parameters
messages.body_plain:
Dear Maaslin Users,
I have a question about parameters dMinAbd and dMinSamp. In manual it is said:

"dMinAbd: The minimum relative abundance allowed in the data. Values below this are removed and imputed as the median of the sample data. [Default %default]"

In code I think I've found the string where features with values less then dMinAbd in more then dMinSamp percent of samples are removed  (BoostGLM.R str 249). But I didn't understand what does it mean: "imputed as the median of the sample data" and did't find the code that could explain it to me in the package. Could you please explain the algorithm we use for filtering features.

Thank you very much!
